concerns.text: Phase 7 mixes simulated interaction logs with real‑student logs in the primary mixed‑effects regression (FR‑006). This violates FR‑020, which mandates that simulation‑generated data be used only for exploratory diagnostics and must not contribute to primary hypothesis testing. Consequently, SC‑004 (which expects inference on the combined dataset) is in conflict with the constitution’s Educational Evaluation Rigor principle and the functional requirement that simulation data be excluded from causal claims.
